story_title: As an Event Operations Manager, I want to assign an Event Coordinator to an event so that there is a clear person responsible for coordinating it

acceptance_criteria.text: An authorised user can assign a coordinator to an event.
The Event Operations Manager can view or filter submitted events that do not yet have an assigned coordinator.
The assigned coordinator is recorded against the event.
The assigned coordinator can view and manage the event.
The Event Organiser can see the assigned coordinator where appropriate.
An event can be reassigned to another coordinator.

open_questions: NOTE: Test data comes from scripts/seed-spm30.ts (npm run fixtures:spm30). It only deletes and recreates events whose seed key starts with 'spm30_'; the rest of the database is untouched. Run it before a full pass, and wherever a case's 'Data reset' line says to.

NOTE: TC20 (empty state) runs on the shared database. It assigns the two base-seed events that start in the queue, so it must run last and be followed by `npm run fixtures:spm30`, which puts them back (if another story has since moved one past Under review, the script leaves it and says so; `-- --restore-queue` forces it). If the queue holds any other event (e.g. one a teammate created in the app), TC20 says to stop rather than assign it, because the script cannot restore it.
NOTE: Organisers from an unrelated company not seeing the event is covered by SPM-31 (visibility), so it is not repeated here.
